# `cot`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the cotangent of `expr`, as if computed by `1/java.lang.Math.tan`.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
cot(expr)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.3.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- cot, example 1
> SELECT cot(1);
0.6420926159343306
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 2.3.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
